page.overview:
Who is Allik?

Allik Neverfar is a Southern Scadrian, a member of the crew of the airship Brunstell, which was capturedthumb by the Set in Bands of Mourning. Allik plays a major role in the last act of Bands of Mourning as a non-viewpoint character.
